scientific_scope: matched evaluator diagnostic within canonical DINOv2-B CLS CUB-200 full-data SimpleCIL; not a new CIL method or leaderboard claim

source.result_root: output root of src/sdg_simplecil_matched.py (canonical feature run)

schedule.prediction_domain: all and only classes seen through the current session
schedule.query_inventory: official test examples belonging to currently seen classes

methods.cos: L2-normalized query dot L2-normalized arithmetic class mean
methods.wcos: total-covariance whitening followed by cosine NCM
methods.lda: equal-prior shared pooled-within-covariance LDA with arithmetic class means

train_only_selection.split_rule: within each class, rank official train paths by sha256('sdg-caev-simplecil-fulldata-evaluator-v1\0'+label+'\0'+path); hold out round(0.2*n), capped at 50 and clamped to [1,n-1]
train_only_selection.split_stability: one fixed per-class split shared by every session, class-order seed, and evaluator
train_only_selection.selection_data: inner-train and validation features from currently seen classes only
train_only_selection.tie_rule: first maximum in ascending candidate grid
train_only_selection.refit: after selection, refit means and covariance on all official train features of currently seen classes
train_only_selection.test_access: none; test labels are used only after predictions are frozen

covariance_update.wcos: recompute total mean/covariance from all currently seen official train features at every session
covariance_update.lda: recompute pooled within-class covariance from all currently seen official train features at every session
covariance_update.numerics: float64 evaluator arithmetic with finite-value checks

memory_assumption.declared_reason: evaluator-only diagnostic reuses the immutable 5994x768 canonical feature cache; it is not an exemplar-free or memory-matched SimpleCIL system claim

reporting.session_metric: overall accuracy over official test examples from currently seen classes
reporting.average_accuracy: arithmetic mean of ten session accuracies
reporting.final_accuracy: overall accuracy in session 9 over all 200 classes
reporting.base_novel_split: not reported because the standard 10-task full-data schedule has no FSCIL base/novel role
reporting.confidence_interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over the 20 paired class-order seeds
